angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 433,421 km at 40.92 pc = 0.14 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 24.4404 +/- 0.0160 mas (same row, RUWE 1.17): 40.92 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.623 +/- 0.012 solar radii from Osborne et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-544 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.52711138O/abstract): 433,421 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.631 +/- 0.018 solar masses from Osborne et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-544 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.52711138O/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4169 +/- 70 K from Osborne et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-544 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.52711138O/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Osborne et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-544 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.52711138O/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-544.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.649, rounded to two decimals

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
